name: DonorGiftEntryConsole
tagline: Key, balance, approve, post and thank every gift – batch gift entry for fundraising teams in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete gift-processing app for charities: keyboard-first quick entry with donor look-up, fund splits, soft credits, tributes and Gift Aid; batches balanced against control totals; duplicate detection and validation rules; four-eyes approval; batch posting; and a thank-you receipt queue with ready-made letters. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Batch control count and total with live variance
Quick entry with donor look-up and Enter-to-add
Gift Aid flag, eligibility rules and claimable value
Possible duplicate detection with confirm or void
Four-eyes approval and large-gift approval comments
Thank-you receipt queue with SLA and letter preview
Bulk validate, approve, void and export
controlType: standard (2 controls: DonorGiftEntryConsole data-set, DonorGiftEntryConsolePortal field)
